TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Narrative Zoning and Development Analysis
5353 South Archer Avenue

L2 Equities, LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property located
at 5353 South Archer Avenue (“Property”). The Property is currently improved with a 1-story brick
building in which Midas Chicago, an auto repair facility, formerly operated. The Subject Property also
includes ten (10) on-site, exterior parking spaces. Midas Chicago ceased operations at the Subject Property
and the Subject Property was rezoned to the existing RS-2 zoning district via Aldermanic ordinance on
June 12, 2024 (#02024-0008857).

The Applicant is seeking to acquire the Subject Property and plans to re-establish auto repair use at the
Subject Property. In order to do so, the Applicant is seeking to amend the Subject Property’s existing
RS-2 zoning district to the Subject Property’s former B3-1 zoning district. There are no proposed additions
or expansions to the Existing Building.

The Property contains a total of 9,876 sf. and is located at the southwest corner of South Archer Avenue
and South Keating Avenue. The adjacent zoning districts to the Subject Property include the B3-1 zoning
district to its north, east and west, and RS-2 zoning district to its south. The Subject Property is a Transit-
served location due to its close proximity to the Archer Avenue bus route corridor (125 ft.).

(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:
i. Lot Area: 9,876 sf.
ii. Total building area: 3,612 sf.
ili. Floor Area Ratio (FAR): .37

(b) Density (Lot Area per Dwelling Unit): Not applicable (no dwelling units)
(c) Parking: Ten (10) vehicular parking spaces
(d) Setbacks:

i, Front setback: 0’
ii. Rear setback : 2’-3” (existing)
iii. Side setbacks:

- East side setback: 4.0’ (minimum/existing)
- West side setback: 2.9’ (existing)

(e) Building height Existing

(f) No. of parking spaces: Ten (10)
(g) Off-street loading: NA
